intended_object: Transport of a power basis along an R-algebra isomorphism. A power basis of S, with generator g, becomes the power basis of S' generated by e(g). Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition keeps the same dimension. It maps the basis by the linear equivalence underlying e and takes e pb.gen as the generator. It proves that the i-th basis vector is (e gen)^i using map_pow. This is exactly the standard transport of a power basis. Requiring S' to be a CommRing, while S is only a Ring, loses nothing. Any algebra with a power basis over a commutative ring is generated by one element and is therefore commutative, so any S' isomorphic to it is commutative too. The setting is the same as that of PowerBasis itself.
